name: Cable Single-Arm Bent-Over Reverse Fly
steps: Stand beside a low pulley, take its handle in your far hand and hinge until your torso is nearly horizontal.
Lift the working arm out to the side until it is level with your back.
Guide the handle down and across toward the pulley.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep the elbow softly bent and your chest facing the floor.
Avoid rotating your torso open to help lift the handle.
